transfer.backupIntro: Save a copy of your library, reading data, notes and quotes as a file you keep (Drive, email, computer…).
transfer.backupSummary: Backup from {{date}}: {{books}} books, {{sessions}} sessions, {{quotes}} quotes, {{notes}} journal entries.
transfer.replaceBody: Your current library will be deleted and replaced by the backup. This can't be undone.
transfer.privacyNote: Exports are created on your phone and shared only where you choose. BookNest has no server.
transfer.deleteAllBody: Books, covers, sessions, goals, quotes, journal and settings will be erased from this phone. Your Premium purchase is not affected.
transfer.deleteAllFinal: Last check: this permanently erases everything. Export a backup first if you might need it.
transfer.csvIntro: Import books from a CSV file, for example an export from another reading app or a spreadsheet. Nothing is overwritten: you'll see a preview first.
transfer.csvColumns: Recognized columns: Title (required), Author, ISBN, Pages, Status/Shelf, Rating, Date Read, Date Started, Publisher, Year, Format, Genre, Language, Price, Currency, Notes.
transfer.quotaWarning_one: The free plan has room for {{count}} more book: the rest will be skipped.
transfer.quotaWarning_other: The free plan has room for {{count}} more books: the rest will be skipped.
transfer.skippedLimit_one: {{count}} book over the free limit skipped.
transfer.skippedLimit_other: {{count}} books over the free limit skipped.

issues.invalid_pages: Page count not understood — left empty.
issues.invalid_date: Date not understood or in the future — ignored.
issues.finish_before_start: Finish date before start date — start date ignored.
issues.pages_beyond_total: Current page beyond the page count.

duplicateReason.isbn: Same ISBN as a book you have.
duplicateReason.title_author: Same title and author as a book you have.
duplicateReason.title: Same title as a book you have.

privacy.headline: Your reading life stays yours.
privacy.summary: BookNest works without an account and without a server. Everything is stored on this phone.

local.title: Local by default
local.body: Books, sessions, goals, reviews and settings live in a database on your phone.

notes.title: Notes and quotes are private
notes.body: They are never sent anywhere: not to advertisers, not to analytics, not in notifications.

ads.title: Ads (free version)
ads.body: Small banners on browsing screens only, never while you read or write. Ads never receive your reading content.

analytics.title: Anonymous statistics (optional)
analytics.body: Only if you allow it: anonymous usage events, never titles, notes or quotes.

permissions.title: Minimal permissions
permissions.body: No camera, microphone, contacts or location. Covers are picked with Android's photo picker.

covers.title: Cover images
covers.body: Saved as compressed files inside the app's private storage, deleted with the book.

delete.title: Export or delete anytime
delete.body: Profile › Backup lets you export everything or erase all data.

privacy.analyticsHint: Helps improve BookNest. Off by default.

premium.headline: Your library, without limits
premium.subtitle: Support an independent app and unlock everything.

features.advanced_journal: Journal filters by type and tag, Markdown export

premium.freeForever: The free version stays free: your data is never locked.
premium.nothingToRestore: No purchase found for this Google account.

premium.olderHistory_other: {{count}} older sessions are kept but hidden in the free plan.
